label: Excess-profit tax draws employer pushback
text: The finance ministry's ZKPO package introduces a 33 % one-off levy on excess profit for banks, fast-loan firms, insurers, telecoms, exchange bureaux and food-retail chains with 5+ outlets; БТПП backed the tax package in principle on 26 Oct but abstained on the ZKPO chapter and rejects offsetting the levy against investments.
